info.name: GitHub Update an Attribute for Scim Enterprise Group

params.name: scim_group_id
params.description: A unique identifier of the SCIM group.

items.docs:
**Note:** The SCIM API endpoints for enterprise accounts are currently in *private* beta and are subject to change.

Update a provisioned group’s individual attributes.

To change a group’s values, you must provide a specific Operations JSON format that contains at least one of the add, remove, or replace operations.
